title: [Interview] Czech MEP Niedermayer slams Babiš opposition to new EU budget revenue: ‘It’s short-sighted’
lede: From missed IT revolutions to costly nuclear bets, EU Parliament's economic policy vice-chair Luděk Niedermayer sketches a stark choice for European capitalks: keep blaming Brussels for their woes, clinging to national budgets, or allow the EU to levy its own targeted taxes on negative externalities to better compete with the US and China.
